content.short: Tropical Charles is the FIRST community-built NFT collection on Cardano with in-game utility at the Cardabbean Islands Metaverse.
content.description: Welcome to the Tropical Charles CNFT Collection. Charles Hoskinson will receive his own island from Cardabbean. We don't give a damn if he takes it or not. We will develop his island. Period! If you discover Tropical Charles strolling around his island, you may listen to what he has to say. This CNFT will allow you to shoot yourself from a pirate cannon at the island plaza directly to Tropical Charles secret island. There are 10,000 one of a kind Tropical Charles to be collected. Simply list your CNFT in marketplaces and flip it after you've visited the island and become weary of Charles. We asked our community to help us to collaborate and design Tropical Charles by sharing ideas.
